title: Writing for Voltera
slide_intent: Teach writers how to sound knowledgeable and approachable to an international audience. A concrete detail can carry expertise where slang or an obscure joke may distract.
strategic_value: Voltera can express technical competence through direct examples while keeping its writing understandable across audiences.
demonstration: Voice principles occupy one column and two paired writing examples occupy the other. The examples contrast plain descriptions and a dated product fact with casual slang.
practical_value: Test a sentence by replacing a slang phrase with a specific fact or familiar description and comparing the resulting tone.
